scope: Retain the existing 106-passage baseline and add selected everyday-care and developmental education. Do not release any health-review-blocked candidate, even when it shares a publisher with everyday-care material. No diagnosis, treatment, immunisation schedule or clinical approval is introduced.

source_checks.finding: Selected social, communication, attention and supervised awake movement summaries match the named sections; clinical feeding quantities and diagnostic checklist are excluded.
Selected responsive play, sound imitation, everyday conversation and reaching summaries match the source. Pointing describes the caregiver's action, not a required four-month milestone.
Selected mirror play, sound turns, grasping and supervised reaching summaries match the source. Feeding quantities and milestone diagnosis are not selected.
Selected child-led interaction, books, hidden-object play and movement descriptions match the source. The summary does not recommend its small-object example or diagnose from milestone timing.
Selected dressing participation, gestures, containers and supervised movement match the sections. Variation and professional review of lost skills are distinguished from a diagnostic checklist.
Selected caring gestures, pointing/name-sharing, pretend play and routine participation match the source; no treatment or diagnostic threshold is selected.

Selected ordinary food-texture, handwashing and responsive feeding summaries preserve six-month eligibility and the narrower nine-to-eleven-month selection. Illness care, feed quantities and individualized nutrition decisions are excluded.
Age-labelled interaction and safe-object examples match the named sections. Meal/medical quantities, small-object recommendations and rigid attainment claims are excluded.
Selected day/night distinction, calming routines and first-six-month room-sharing match the source. Sleep-duration promises, feeding withdrawal, sleep training and UK service pathways are excluded.
Selected preparation, temperature checking, support, continuous supervision and gentle washing match the source. No UK service pathway or treatment advice is selected.
Selected small-object/cord precautions, fall prevention and continuous water supervision match the source. They are injury prevention, not accident treatment or a complete safety assessment.
Selected age-suitable toy precautions and supervised seated eating match the source. Emergency treatment and UK product-standard claims are not copied.
